summary: Backend testing of 8 AI feature endpoints in /api/ai/* and /api/public/ai/chatbot. Created /app/backend/tests/test_ai_endpoints.py with 20 pytest cases covering all 13 review-request scenarios. Real OpenAI calls via Emergent universal key. Final result: 20/20 passed (100%).

minor.issue: Returns {ok: true} even when the suggestion id does not exist (no 404). Not blocking — UI never calls it with a fake id — but consider returning 404 when matched_count==0 for stricter API contract.

`setdefault('taxable', True)` does not coerce when the LLM explicitly returns taxable=false on a non-taxable line item (e.g. a warranty). This may be intentional (preserve LLM judgement), but the SYSTEM_ESTIMATE_GEN prompt hard-codes `taxable: true` so the inconsistency is worth a comment in code.

action_items: Optional: ai_service.py — when LLM returns taxable=false despite the prompt mandating true, decide whether to override or keep. Currently kept. Add an inline comment to make intent explicit.
Optional: routers/ai.py dismiss_maintenance — consider 404 when matched_count==0 for tenant-isolation guarantees.
critical_code_review_comments: Audit logging works as designed — ai_logs entries contain feature, model, success, input_chars, output_chars, created_at, company_id, user_id; failure path also writes a log row with success=false and error<=500 chars (verified by reading log entries via /api/ai/logs).
Multi-tenant isolation verified: /api/ai/jobs/summarize and /api/ai/jobs/upsell both 404 for job_ids that don't belong to the calling company (filter `id, company_id`).
RBAC on /api/ai/logs correctly restricts to owner/admin/office_manager — dispatcher receives 403.
Public chatbot endpoint properly 404s for invalid company_id and saves both user+assistant turns to chatbot_messages collection.
_extract_json defensively strips ```json fences and falls back to outermost-brace scan — robust.
Estimate tier normalization correctly handles both `tiers:[...]` and `{good,better,best}` dict shapes.

Recommend: add `index` on (company_id, customer_id, status) for maintenance_suggestions and (company_id, session_id, created_at) for chatbot_messages if not already present in server.py startup. Visible from server.py — main agent's claim is that indexes are created; we did not enumerate them via $listIndexes in this run.
test_credentials: demo@a1fieldpro.com / Demo1234! (owner), dispatcher@a1fieldpro.com / Demo1234! (dispatcher used for 403 RBAC check). Source: /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded demo company + first existing job for job_id-based tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests at /app/backend/tests/test_ai_endpoints.py are pytest-compatible and reusable. Each run consumes Emergent LLM key credits (~10 OpenAI calls per full run). Skipping the maintenance scan or shortening prompts can reduce credit burn. If you need to retest, prefer `-k` filtering to a single class. The /api/ai/logs endpoint always returns logs from prior runs so the test_logs_for_owner case is non-flaky once any AI call has executed.
rca_of_the_issue: Only one initial failure: test_generate_estimate_shape asserted `taxable is True` on every line_item, but GPT-4o legitimately marked a 'Manufacturer Warranty' line item taxable=false. Per the review-request guidance ('assert response shape and status code rather than exact AI content'), relaxed the assertion to check that `taxable` is a bool. After fix: 20/20 pass. No backend bug — purely a too-strict test assertion.
